proposed_facts.reason: Canonical short-circuit evaluation avoids dereferencing only when BootInfo is null. The zero-field fallback reads consoleType; neither path writes state.

The assembly adapter unconditionally branches to __OSUnhandledException after context capture and fault-register reads. The dispatcher gates recovery on MSR_RI, restores context after registered callbacks, and explicitly restores recoverable decrementer contexts without requiring a callback. Other paths reach diagnostics and PPCHalt.

The getter directly indexes OSExceptionTable after ASSERTMSGLINE. macros.h invokes OSPanic on assertion failure only when DEBUG is defined and otherwise expands the assertion to a no-op. No independent initialization or bounds check exists.

OSException.h defines __OSException as u8, the callback signature as stated, and MAX as 14 + 1. The setter exchanges and returns the indexed callback; its assertion is build-dependent rather than a type-enforced domain.
